But we need to be careful: listing all files in C drive might be huge. Maybe we can just list root directory? The user didn't specify depth. We can do something like "dir C:\ /s /b > testing.txt" to list all files recursively. But that might be too large. Alternatively, we can just create an empty file testing.txt. The user says "list file in c drive and make file called testing.txt". So maybe they want to list files and also create a file. We can combine commands: "dir C:\ /s /b > testing.txt". That will create testing.txt with the list. Or we can first list and then create an empty file. But the simplest is to run "dir C:\ /s /b > testing.txt". Let's do that. We'll call the tool.
